verdict.rationale: Airbyte's schema change management docs say each connection can be configured for how Airbyte handles source schema changes. That is a user-chosen, per-connection policy rather than silent breakage. The evidence is a single first-party statement, so the specific policy options and how detection works are not spelled out. Missing for 10: the enumerated policy options (e.g., propagate, ignore, pause), explicit description of the detection mechanism and schema-change alerting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, upstream schema changes are detected and propagated by a policy I choose, instead of silently breaking loads

citations.quote: You can specify for each connection how Airbyte should handle any change of schema in the source.
